source_text.body:
Generate media and push it to Telegram bots
A user runs n8n workflows that use image generation and text-to-speech tools and send the content to the right Telegram bot.
·
Feb 10, 2025
Done with
N8
n8n
What they did
The source is a comment in a Reddit thread, not a full walkthrough. The commenter contrasts a more autonomous setup, where an AI is taught to use image-generation and text-to-speech tools from API docs or ComfyUI, with a simpler n8n approach where you build fixed workflows and have them send the generated content to the appropriate Telegram bot.
How it went
It reports those on-the-fly agentic runs can work, but with mixed results. There are no concrete performance numbers, volumes, or outcomes for the Telegram workflow itself.
Worth knowing
The clearest catch is reliability: the commenter says the more autonomous version produces mixed results, while the n8n version is described as just building workflows and routing output.
Try it yourself
with
n8n
Copy prompt
Build an n8n workflow that takes [trigger, e.g. a daily schedule or a topic list], generates an image with [image tool] and a voiceover with [text-to-speech tool], and sends them to Telegram bot [bot name or chat ID]. Route content to the right bot based on [rule, e.g. topic]. Run one test to a private chat and show me the output before I turn on the schedule.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/n8n/comments/1qjysot/calling_n8n_workflows_ai_agents_causes_confusion
